device.description: 8-bit 2.5 us modified-flash microprocessor-compatible ADC with track-and-hold and 3-state outputs
device.note: tlc0820a.pdf (SLAS064A) p.1 (2-1) pinout, p.3 (2-3) terminal functions, p.4 (2-4) recommended operating conditions, p.5 (2-5) operating characteristics (ta(R2), tdis, td(int)), p.7-8 (2-7, 2-8) Figures 1-4

commands.name: Start conversion (write-read mode: CS and WR low)
commands.note: p.3: in the write-read mode (MODE high) the conversion starts on the WR falling edge; td(int) runs from WR rising (p.5)

pages: p.1 (2-1, pinout), p.3 (2-3, terminal functions), p.4 (2-4, ROC), p.5 (2-5, operating characteristics), p.7-8 (2-7/2-8, Figures 1-4)
notModeled: analog input, REF+/REF- span (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
only the write-read mode (MODE high) is modeled: WR/RDY is the WR input, CS+WR starts the conversion and INT goes low td(int) (1300 ns max) after WR rises. The MODE pin is not read

read mode (MODE low, the power-on default: MODE has an internal 50 uA pull-down): RD low starts the conversion and the data appear at its end (tconv(R) 2.5 us max) in the same read; WR/RDY is then RDY, an open-drain output low after CS falls until the result is latched
write-read mode reading before td(int) (RD low earlier latches the result after RD falls, INT low at td(RIL) 290 ns max; ta(R1) 320 ns)
INT is reset by the rising edge of either RD or CS (p.3); the model clears it when the read ends
OFLW overflow output (normally high, low when the input exceeds REF+) is not driven
conversion starts at the WR falling edge in the datasheet; the model starts it when WR/CS are released and times td(int) from there (which is how the datasheet times INT)
tw(W) 0.5-50 us write pulse, td(NC) 500 ns between conversions, td(WR) 0.4 us
tAcc uses ta(R2) 150 ns (CL = 100 pF, td(WR) > td(int)); tDf uses tdis 95 ns
pin names: REF - / REF + written REF- / REF+; D0 (LSB) / D7 (MSB) written D0 / D7; the FN (PLCC) package is obsolete and not in the skeleton
variants: TLC0820AC (0-70 C) and TLC0820AI (-40-85 C) share the datasheet; direct replacement for the ADC0820 (p.1)
